reasons.plausibility: Drawing on established concepts of sluggish diffusion and enhanced stability in high-entropy alloys, the proposed mechanism of lattice distortion impeding diffusion is scientifically robust.
reasons.testability: The design of a direct comparison with a lower-entropy baseline, combined with standard analytical methods (TEM, XRD, APT), allows a clear and decisive test of the proposed diffusion-limiting effect.
reasons.usefulness: If validated, this hypothesis would offer a valuable guideline for designing high-temperature nanoalloys via exploitation of configurational entropy, making the study highly relevant to researchers.
